title.en: Mehar and the Lion in the Well
title.de: Mehar und der Löwe im Brunnen

inspired_by: The Lion and the Clever Hare, from the Panchatantra
learning: Thinking cleverly, and being kind even to someone who was unkind

characters.name: Raja Singh
characters.who: a proud, bossy lion who calls himself king of the jungle

characters.name: Hasi
characters.who: a small bunny with very long ears and a very big heart

characters.name: Moti
characters.who: a gentle elephant who greets everyone in Hindi

characters.name: Uhu
characters.who: a wise owl who speaks German

pages.text: Mehar found a dusty old book under her bed. On the cover, in gold letters, it said: Panchatantra. The moment she opened it, whoosh! Golden light swirled out and pulled her inside.

She landed in a jungle where the animals could talk. But nobody was smiling. "Every evening Raja Singh the lion demands one of us for dinner," whispered Uhu the owl. "And tonight... it is Hasi's turn."
From his big grey rock, the lion roared so loudly that the leaves shook. "ROAAAR! I am the king! Bring me my dinner before the moon comes up!"
Hasi's ears drooped. But Mehar had been thinking. "A lion has big muscles," she said, "but we have clever minds." She cupped her hands and whispered a secret plan into Hasi's long, long ear.

So Hasi did something very strange. She walked... very... slowly. She sniffed every flower and counted every cloud, and she even took a little nap. By the time they reached the lion, the moon was already up.
"YOU ARE LATE!" thundered Raja Singh. Hasi bowed low. "Forgive me, Your Majesty! Another lion stopped us on the way. He says HE is the real king of this jungle, and you are nobody!"
"ANOTHER king?" The lion's mane stood up like a bush. "Nobody is king but ME! Take me to him, right now!" So Mehar and Hasi led him through the dark to an old stone well.

"He lives down there," said Mehar. Raja Singh peered into the well. An angry lion with a crown glared back up at him! He roared, and the lion in the well roared right back. (Can you guess who it really was?)
SPLASH! The lion leapt in to fight his rival, and landed in cold, cold water, all alone. It had only been his own reflection! "Help!" he spluttered. "The walls are too slippery. I can't climb out!"
The animals cheered. But Mehar did not. "He was mean," she said, "but we don't leave anyone in trouble." Everyone went quiet. Then Moti stepped forward and lowered his long trunk deep into the well.

Raja Singh climbed out, dripping and shivering, and his crown was gone. He looked at the little bunny and the girl. "You tricked me, and then you saved me. I am sorry." From that day on he ate mangoes and bananas, and he guarded the jungle instead of scaring it.
Whoosh! The golden light swirled again, and Mehar was back in bed. She peeked into the book. On the very last page was a brand-new picture of a girl, a bunny, and a smiling lion with no crown.

moral.en: A clever mind is stronger than big muscles. And being kind, even to someone who was unkind to you, is the strongest thing of all.
moral.de: Ein kluger Kopf ist stärker als große Muskeln. Und Freundlichkeit ist das Stärkste von allem.
moral.hi: बुद्धि बल से बड़ी होती है, और दया सबसे बड़ी ताक़त है।
moral.hi_roman: Buddhi bal se badi hoti hai, aur daya sabse badi taakat hai.

questions.en: Why did Hasi walk so slowly?
Who was the lion in the well, really?
questions.de: Wer war der Löwe im Brunnen wirklich?
questions.hi: कुएँ में असली में कौन था?
